candidates.statement: Redis reserve_inventory operations time out (~2s) on the inventory service, causing inventory /v1/reservations to return 503, order to fail with ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout to return 502.
candidates.uncertainty: Traces show the timeout but not the underlying Redis cause (saturation, network, or config); logs were excluded.

report.explanation: Traces show redis.reserve_inventory timing out (~2s) with DependencyUnavailable, inventory returning 503, order ReadTimeout, and gateway /v1/checkout 502. Metrics show elevated checkout p95 (~2.4s) and 502s. Topology confirms inventory->redis. Bounded candidate: redis-timeout.
missing_evidence: Redis server-side metrics/logs (latency, connections, saturation) to confirm the timeout origin
Inventory service logs correlating the redis.reserve_inventory failures
